blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Oriental Mindoro Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan is pushing to develop the shipbuilding and ship repair industry, saying it could generate jobs, boost industrialization, and support the modernization of the Philippine Navy and Coast Guard. The House Committee on Trade and Industry held an initial deliberation on House Bill No. 134, filed by Panaligan, which seeks to promote the Philippine shipbuilding and ship repair industry and reform government policies affecting the sector. In his social media post, Panaligan said expanding and revitalizing domestic shipbuilding could help jump-start the country’s reindustrialization by creating jobs and generating income and government revenues.
